The '''homeworld''' of [[Trebold Raynor]] was the rumored resting place of the [[Platinum Pickaxe]]. [[Gan Alno]], head of [[Raynor Mining Enterprises]] during the [[Galactic War]], hired treasure hunters to search Raynor's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] for the pickaxe.
